source.title: GT-G3-00 G3 Basic Canonical Canvas P30 Implementation Plan v0.1

supporting_inputs.skia_fetch_command: python3 tools/skia/fetch.py --target macos-arm64-metal --variant release --profile tools/skia/profiles/r1-full-v1.json --lock r1-full-skia-sdk.lock.json --install-root .deps/skia-sdk --summary-file out/g3-05-skia-sdk-resolution.json

trusted_statements.goal: Implement a private Skia-backed Headless backend that consumes the immutable G3-04 FramePlan and produces deterministic raster/readback evidence.

fixed_raster_contract.coordinate_rule: Apply ReferenceDrawList.worldToView, then RuntimeSceneRecord.transform; fixture geometry is integer-aligned and channel conversion is deterministic round-to-nearest-even.

nine_kind_mapping.Shape: fill transformed visualBounds with the fixture solid color
nine_kind_mapping.Image: resource_id-keyed 2x2 checkerboard placeholder; no external decode or lookup
nine_kind_mapping.VectorPath: fill the fixture polygon/path with integer-aligned edges and the fixture color
nine_kind_mapping.RichText: draw deterministic run-glyph placeholder cells keyed by Unicode scalar/run sequence; no platform font lookup
nine_kind_mapping.VectorStroke: draw fixture axis-aligned segments with butt caps and no antialiasing
nine_kind_mapping.DabStroke: draw deterministic integer-aligned square dabs from center, size, and opacity
nine_kind_mapping.Connector: draw straight or orthogonal axis-aligned fixture segments
nine_kind_mapping.Sticky: fill transformed width/height bounds with the fixed sticky color
nine_kind_mapping.Group: preserve traversal order and contribute zero pixels

trusted_statements.resource_and_rejection_policy: Unsupported external resources, invalid dimensions, mismatched plan identity, unsupported geometry or erase mask, and arithmetic overflow return typed rejection and preserve the prior successful observation. The fixture supports only its explicit rectangular/path erase mask; masks are never silently ignored.
forbidden: Skia types in public Render Core headers
RuntimeScene, SceneQuery, SemanticDocument, or G2 contract changes
Tile, RenderGroup, RasterCache, Scheduler, or ResourceBudget behavior
